generate_json_schema: generate the JSON Schema of a pydantic model from a class reference string
run_generate_jsonschema_cli: run the CLI to print the JSON Schema of a docling_core pydantic model
import_class_dynamic: dynamically import a class from a dotted module path string
test_generate_json_schema: test the generate_json_schema function with a valid pydantic model reference
review_main_cli: review the main CLI entry point that parses arguments and prints JSON Schema output
